p.title: Durable completed-session ETF rotation producer and native consumer
p.symptom: RRG and sector performance remained empty when browser-side Yahoo history hydration was unavailable, although the scheduled producer already had a market-data collection lane.
p.root_cause: No durable ETF relative-rotation artifact existed. Each visitor depended on an external browser hydration request; stored screener rows did not contain the required aligned daily histories.
p.fix: Add a bounded SPY plus 25 ETF daily adjusted-close collector and derived rotation artifact to the existing Actions producer. Align exact session dates, verify provider instrument/timeframe/currency and completed-session grace, compute RRG plus one/five-session returns, reuse the same completed session without requests, and retain failed observations without advancing their timestamp. The native provider consumes validated current derived rows. No raw stock/ETF prices are published; T3 reference and rights-review limits remain.
p.violated_rule: P715 raw-price publication boundary; R677 observation/session identity; R679 descriptive reference semantics.
p.prevention: QA-SEMANTIC-ROTATION-01; ci-rotation-history-check plus P1358 native consumer fixtures are registered in the QA pipeline.
p.verification: Producer mock gate PASS for 25 ETF coverage, 26 bounded requests, concurrency 3, zero same-session requests, date intersection, holidays, DST/half-days, type conflicts, missing evidence and failed-refresh retention. Consumer positive/negative units PASS. Real Actions production and a browser rendering newly produced real rotation remain unverified; no local producer or workflow dispatch ran.

qa.text: The durable derived RRG artifact reaches the native provider while preserving aligned completed sessions, raw-price limits, failed observations and reference-only use.
qa.verify_by: P1358 ci-rotation-history-check + ci-esm-core-unit-check + Actions producer run + real-data themes screenshot
